Larger descriptions and small info icons in the build bar help explain your buildings.The tutorial flows more smoothly, with fewer confirmation clicks, clearly highlighted building tasks, and a better-paced first attack. events.title: The Xenogarden Demo is Now Live!
events.summary: Grow your hive, spread your synapses, assimilate the world around you, and defend your heart against increasingly dangerous waves.The demo gives you a first taste of Xenogarden's core gameplay and of what we want to expand further as development continues.If you give it a try, we'd love to hear your feedback, bug reports, and impressions.Thank you to everyone who has followed and supported Xenogarden so far. 🌱See you in the garden.— Xenogarden

events.title: Your Army Is Alive. What Will You Grow?
events.summary: Your army is alive.In Xenogarden, Guardians evolve into specialized brood: armored defenders, relentless hunters, venom carriers and living healers.Every form has a purpose. Every strength has a trade-off.Which brood would you grow?Why build evolution this way?I want growing your army to feel like shaping a living colony. Armor buys staying power at the cost of speed. Hunters chase exposed prey. Healers keep the brood alive.The goal is a brood whose roles support each other.

Perfect growth.Her crystals are neither ordinary minerals nor traditional ice magic. They are living tissue – structures grown by the hive itself, transforming biological matter into something almost unnatural: hard, precise, and strangely beautiful.Auralis herself appears distant. events.summary: Today, I would like to introduce another leader from Xenogarden: Veyra.While Selquara represents thorns, control, and a slowly growing defensive network, Veyra embodies a far more restless side of the hive. Her theme revolves around brood, poison, and biological adaptation.Veyra does not see the Xenogarden as a fortress. To her, it is a living organism that must constantly evolve.
